name: prompt-optimizer-skill
description: A professional Claude Code Skill that transforms simple instructions into production-ready prompts. Based on the CLARITY framework, supports 61 prompt frameworks, and provides quality validation with multi-version output.

scripts.postversion: node -e "var v=require('./package.json').version,f=require('fs'),u=(p,r)=>{var c=f.readFileSync(p,'utf-8');f.writeFileSync(p,c.replace(r,v))};f.writeFileSync('VERSION',v+'\n');u('claude.json',/(?<=\"version\":\s*\")[^\"]+/);u('.claude-plugin/marketplace.json',/(?<=\"version\":\s*\")[^\"]+/g);u('frameworks/index.json',/(?<=\"version\":\s*\")[^\"]+/)" && git add VERSION claude.json .claude-plugin/marketplace.json frameworks/index.json

author: dreamor
